channel.title: 3ABN Sabbath School Panel
channel.desc: Join us this week to rediscover the power of gratitude and grace. Paul begins his letters with words of greeting and thanksgiving: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ (Colossians 1:2-3). He reminds us that we, too, have experienced grace beyond measure and can have peace that surpasses understanding. Though human gratitude often falters, God's love never fails.
